Q5242.reason: A spouse has a duty to warn; intentionally withholding a warning she knows will let her husband be killed supplies malice and is murder, while the other choices are manslaughter, negligence, or a superseding act.

Q5244.reason: Anal fissure classically makes digital rectal exam exquisitely painful; bright-red blood is distal, proctoscopy is useful, and hemorrhoids—not cancer—are the commonest cause.

Q5251.reason: An arm above heart level lowers hydrostatic pressure at the cuff, so the measured reading underestimates true blood pressure.
